Optimized the test suite by introducing reusable database/session, organization, customer, invoice, and payment-method factories; batching customer setup; replacing direct model inserts; and freezing subscription clocks for determinism. Full-suite runtime improved from 42.18s to 14.92s, with 318 passing and 4 skipped. Invoice, payment, customer, subscription, and report suites all pass. This work remains separate from the primary goal of upgrading the Ledgerly models from SQLAlchemy 1.4 to 2.0, which has not yet been implemented.
